intro: AV College and St Ann's PG College for Women both sit in Hyderabad, and this page compares their recorded BA fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in 2026.

AV College vs St Ann's PG College for Women is not a single winner. Both are recorded as private institutes. Pick the campus that matches the programme you want, the fee you can pay, and the admission test you will take.

sections.heading: AV College vs St Ann's PG College for Women for BA: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose AV College if its BA programme, location and recorded outcomes match the kind of work or further study you want.
Choose St Ann's PG College for Women if its course mix, city or recorded fee level is the better fit, rather than looking for one campus that wins on every count.
AV College lists B.A Economics, B.A Political Science, B.A Public Administration. St Ann's PG College for Women lists B.A.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip application, hostel-only or short-course rows so a registration fee is not treated as tuition.
Our records list ₹22,150 a year as tuition fees for AV College's B.A Economics. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.
Our records do not hold a quotable BA programme fee for St Ann's PG College for Women on this page. Confirm the current official fee notice before you budget.
If fees are your only filter, confirm the current official circular for the exact programme and batch you will join, because year figures and older rows can understate the real cost.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: In our records, AV College's 2025 figures include an average package of ₹3.35 lakh for B.A Economics. These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.
Our records do not show a 2020 or later flagship placement year for St Ann's PG College for Women on this page. Ask the institute for its latest official placement report for the same programme.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

paragraphs: Both campuses are in Hyderabad, Telangana. The choice is less about moving city and more about the programme, fees and admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read the official hostel and location notes, before you accept an offer.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
